minimal.customPrompt: Use a calm, minimalist English style. Keep the topic to 3–5 words. Omit the subtitle unless it adds a concrete, useful distinction. Avoid jargon and emoji.

playful.customPrompt: Write in English with a relaxed tone and a little programmer humor, while staying understandable to people unfamiliar with the project. You may use one fitting emoji. Keep the actual work stage clear and do not exaggerate results.
